title: Operation
description: Result of action.approve, operation.get, operation.stop and operation.list entries (m4-actions §3). One per approved plan. A single operation's journal is in steps; a fix operation (m9 §4.1, kind fix) has one entry per step in steps and its journal in history. A script operation (m9 §5.4/§5.7, kind script) has its own lifecycle, options, restore point, receipt and shared output; steps null; never verified, never undone.

kind.description: Present on fix and script operations only.

state.description: partial (m9 §4, terminal): at least one step verified and a later one failed, or the run was stopped. A script (m9 §5.4): prepared → running → completed | failed | stopped | timed_out | not_run | indeterminate.

progress.description: Provider operations: the handler's latest progress line while running. Fix operations: Step n of k.

result.description: Provider operations: updated | already_current | no_threats | threats_found | threats_unknown (scan finished, but Defender's event history was not fully readable); restore points created | reused; repairs (m9 P3b-2) repair.sfc no_violations | repaired | could_not_repair | finished | failed, repair.dism_restorehealth healthy | repaired | finished | failed, and stopped after operation.stop (always present; a timeout or a tool that could not start is failed); network.flush_dns flushed | failed; explorer.restart restarted | started | not_running | failed (report-only, design v59: restarted, started and not_running end the operation and plan completed, never verified or indeterminate; failed ends failed). repair finished: the tool ended but its result lines could not be read.

settingsPath.description: Design v59: the page as Windows names it in English (e.g. Settings › Apps › Startup), sent beside manualUri only when Windows’ display language is English and the page has a known path; absent otherwise.

options.description: Scripts: the dialog's choices, bound in the approval nonce.

restorePoint.description: Scripts: the restore point made first (null when not asked for).

oneOf.description: Scripts: exactly what the AI was sent (the scrubbed last lines), for the card's Sent to <AI>.

leftOut.description: m9 §17.3: a fix operation keeps its plan's left-out steps (receipt).

removed.description: m9 §17.3: a fix operation keeps the steps the user switched off (receipt).

history.description: Fix operations: the append-only transition history.

state.description: completed (m9 §3.8 as built): a tool finished and reported its result (repair.sfc, repair.dism_restorehealth, network.flush_dns); nothing was verified, result says what it reported, the finding stays open.

scriptReceipt.description: m9 §5.4: a script's receipt. exitCode is null for stopped, timed_out, indeterminate and not_run (and when it never started).

restorePoint.description: m9 §5.2: created, reused (Windows returned one from the last 24 hours; at is its time), failed or declined (the script did not run).

receipt.description: verifiedAt for a verified change; completedAt (and no verifiedAt) when a tool only reported its result (state completed).

brokerReceiptId.description: m9 §3.5: the elevated broker's protected record of an administrator write; its undo names it.
m9 §3.5: the elevated broker's protected record of an administrator step; its undo names it.
